import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
D = 48
HEADS = 4
FF = 96
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads, ff):
        super().__init__()
        self.heads = heads
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, ff), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(ff, d))

    def forward(self, t):
        b, n, d = t.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(self.n1(t)).reshape(b, n, 3, self.heads, d // self.heads)
        qkv = qkv.permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, n, d)
        t = t + self.o(a)
        t = t + self.ff(self.n2(t))
        return t


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, D, 3, padding=1)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, spec.Y * spec.X, D) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS, FF) for _ in range(2)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        b, c, y, xx = x.shape
        t = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            t = blk(t)
        t = self.norm(t)
        f = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, c, y, xx)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 3, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
LP = 24
LH = 16


class LayerHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        in_l = c + 6 + 3 + self.Z
        self.proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_l, LP, 1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Conv2d(LP, LP, 1))
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * LP, LH, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(LH, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f, obs):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        build = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        miss = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        extra = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        rest = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3]
        bb = F.pad(build, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        tb = F.pad(tgt, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        per = torch.stack([build, tgt, miss, extra, bb, tb], dim=2)
        onehot = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        restx = rest.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        fx = f.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, f.shape[1], Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([per, restx, onehot, fx], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, -1, Y, X)
        p = self.proj(inp)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1).reshape(B, Z, len(self.fps), Y, X)
        s = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1)
        return s.flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = LayerHead(spec, WIDTH)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f, obs)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

STEM = 64
COL = 48

        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)

        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1, bias=False) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), conv, mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.convs, self.mix, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            if dy * dx == 1:

            else:
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(conv(q) + mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=2, dilation=2)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.gb = nn.Linear(64, WIDTH)
        self.head = ConvPoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c3(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        f2 = F.relu(f + self.gb(g)[:, :, None, None])
        place = self.head(f2)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

            res.append(out(h))

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
LP = 24
LH = 16


class LayerHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        in_l = c + 6 + 3 + self.Z
        self.p1 = nn.Conv2d(in_l, LP, 1)
        self.p2 = nn.Conv2d(2 * LP, LP, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * LP, LH, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(LH, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f, obs):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        build = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        miss = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        extra = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        rest = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3]
        bb = F.pad(build, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        tb = F.pad(tgt, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        per = torch.stack([build, tgt, miss, extra, bb, tb], dim=2)
        onehot = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        restx = rest.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        fx = f.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, f.shape[1], Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([per, restx, onehot, fx], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, -1, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.p1(inp))
        hz = h.reshape(B, Z, LP, Y, X)
        cm = torch.cummax(hz, dim=1)[0]
        below = torch.cat([torch.zeros_like(cm[:, :1]), cm[:, :-1]], dim=1)
        p = self.p2(torch.cat([hz, below], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 2 * LP, Y, X))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            hh = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(hh))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1).reshape(B, Z, len(self.fps), Y, X)
        s = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1)
        return s.flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = LayerHead(spec, WIDTH)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f, obs)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

analyses.1: There are no results yet, and success scores are hidden, so these are three single-theme tests against the starting architecture. Three weak spots stand out. (1) The recipe. The default makes only 32 PPO updates, and gamma 0.95 gives little weight to the +1 exact-build bonus or to the later cost of a misplaced brick. (2) The action head only takes the max, min and mean over each footprint. It cannot weigh which cell of the footprint holds which feature, and that matters for working out where a brick lands and whether it covers cells that are still missing. (3) The trunk only sees a 5x5 neighbourhood. It has no global context to decide what to build first or when to choose DONE. Each candidate isolates one of these, so the later rounds can combine whatever helps.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials trained without errors, but scores are hidden, so I can't compare them. The only feedback left is pass or fail, so each candidate below is my best guess rather than a clean one-change test, and the three are kept different from each other. The hardest part of this task is working out, for each brick and anchor, which layer it lands on (the tallest column under its footprint) and whether the target is filled at that layer. A purely 2D trunk has to squeeze that layer-by-layer comparison into a few channels. So the main new idea gives the head an explicit layer dimension: it scores each footprint at every layer using shared weights, then combines the layers with logsumexp. The second candidate strengthens the conv head and adds global context. The third is a recipe change only: fewer PPO epochs to get about twice the samples, plus a longer horizon. All three stay near or below 1.5x the starting compute and should run well inside the time limit.
analyses.3: No scores are shown, so I can only judge the six trials by design reasoning. All six trained without errors. Two ideas fit the task best. The first is a per-layer action head that shares weights across layers and combines them with logsumexp (r2c1), so the network can learn the landing layer and whether the brick matches the target there. The second is a learned footprint convolution in the head (r1c2). For the recipe, a design stream that never repeats probably rewards fresh samples more than reusing each sample, so 2 PPO epochs (about 1.8 times more samples) plus a long horizon (gamma 0.99, gae_lambda 0.95) is a good guess. The previous trials tested each structural idea with 3 or 4 epochs, so this round pairs each with the 2-epoch recipe. It also adds one new sealing-aware variant: a running maximum over learned features from the layers below, so a placement can tell whether it would cover missing target cells underneath.
analyses.4: No scores are visible, so I can only compare candidates on priors. All 9 trials trained without errors, and no file ran close to the compute or time limits. Three directions look plausible. (1) Spend the budget on more fresh designs: fewer PPO epochs, gamma 0.99, gae_lambda 0.95. (2) Use footprint-shaped learned convolutions in the action head. (3) Use per-layer heads that reason about the landing layer and the cells a brick seals below it, with a running maximum over lower layers. Global context broadcast (r2c2) was only tested together with a costly dilated conv and the 4-epoch recipe. With one round left, the best use of the trials is to combine parts that each looked sound under the high-sample recipe, and to push that recipe one step further (1 epoch, about 3x the samples). Each trial changes one main thing relative to a trial it can be compared with.
